declarations.name: AuiSelect
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Select: `<aui-select>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.
Templates: AuiItem, AuiSelectedItem (`@absoluteui/angular/templates`).

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name (via aria-labelledby).

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: { value, label, disabled?, description? } with unique string values (flat list).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name for the hidden input.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Shown while nothing is selected. Default: localized "Select an option".

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: No selection is invalid; sets aria-required and shows the required indicator.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: aria-disabled, removed from the tab order, not submitted.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Focusable and submitted; the listbox does not open.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: renderOption
inputs.description: Custom option content (since 0.9.0); the label stays the accessible name. Nodes are released with releaseNode when dropped.

inputs.name: renderValue
inputs.description: Custom content for the selected value (since 0.9.0); the label stays the announced value.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Listbox alignment direction (applied when the listbox opens).

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the listbox is shown.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show the listbox; the selected (or first enabled) option becomes active.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Hide the listbox without changing the value.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user selects a new value.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial value, and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Select-Only Combobox pattern: a non-editable combobox that controls a single-select listbox.

limitations: Options are a flat list; option groups are not available.
All options are rendered (no virtualization); lists above 1,000 options are untested.
Typeahead matches label prefixes only (case- and accent-insensitive per Intl.Collator base sensitivity).
